scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json dist/ && bun build src/content/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'content.[ext]' --format iife --watch
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/content/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'content.[ext]' --format iife --minify && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.zip: bun run build && rm -f vercel-folders.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../vercel-folders.zip .
